abstract: Controlling emotional intensity remains challenging in expressive text-to-speech synthesis, particularly when emotion must be inferred without explicit labels. We propose EmoFI-TTS, a face-conditioned framework that derives emotion category and intensity from a single facial image while extracting speaker characteristics from reference audio. Modality-specific representations are fused to condition a pretrained speech synthesizer, with cross-speaker training encouraging separation of affect and vocal identity. An intensity-conditioned refinement module enhances the generated mel-spectrogram, while interpolation of learned intensity embeddings enables continuous control without additional training. On speaker-disjoint MEAD evaluation, EmoFI-TTS achieves on average 64.4% and 75.2% objective and subjective emotion intensity accuracies, while retaining low word error rate and high naturalness.

oneSentenceThesis: EmoFI-TTS 用一张人脸图像同时推断情绪类别和三级强度、用另一段参考音频决定说话人音色，再用强度门控的残差模块增强梅尔谱，在说话人不重叠的 MEAD 测试上达到 64.4% 客观强度准确率，代价是仍依赖离散强度标注训练且 L1（最弱）强度段绕开增强。
